name: no-campaign-ran
about: A day with no campaign spending: no campaign rows, the month's spend so far, and the cohorts.

output.headline: No campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, leaving the day with $0.00 spend and no leads.
points: No ads ran on 2026-11-03: $0.00 spent, 0 impressions, 0 clicks, and no leads across all campaigns.
November 2026 has 28 days left and $400.00 spent so far on Meta with no other platforms active yet.

The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) shows 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion. The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) shows 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 0 hired, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded.
